Orders_Requested: waxaan codsanayaa in dhulkeege la ii.
Remarks:
1.	Preparation: Establishing plans, policies, and trained teams.
2.	Detection & Analysis: Identifying anomalies using SIEM and confirming the incident.
3.	Containment: Isolating systems to stop the spread (e.g., updating firewall rules).
4.	Eradication: Removing the root cause, such as wiping infected drives or patching vulnerabilities.

Orders_Requested: Waxaa sharaf leh inaan halkan ku soo gudbiyo codsigaygan rasmiga ah, aniga oo ka codsanaya hay’adda ay khuseyso inay si degdeg ah oo caddaalad ah u eegto kiiskan. Waxaan si xushmad leh u dalbanayaa in magdhaw buuxa laga bixiyo khasaarihii hantiyadeed iyo midka niyadeed ee aan la kulmay, isla markaana la soo afjaro xadgudubka dhanka xuquuqdayda ah ee uu geystay dhinaca kale. Sidoo kale, waxaan codsanayaa in la soo saaro go'aan rasmi ah oo waajibinaya in si degdeg ah iigu soo laabato hantidii iyo xuquuqdii sharciga ahayd ee la iga hortaagnaa, si loo hubiyo badbaadada iyo dhowrista caddaaladda.
Remarks: Dacwaddani waxay salka ku haysaa khilaaf baahsan iyo xadgudub ka dhashay heshiis iyo xuquuq horey loo yeeshay, kaas oo dhinaca kale uu si ula kac ah u baalmaray mabaadi'da sharciga iyo wada-noolanshaha fiyow. Kadib isku dayo badan oo nabadgelyo iyo wadahadal ah oo guuldareystay, waxaa caddaatay in xalka kaliya uu yahay in arrintan loo soo bandhigo horteeda sharciga. Warbixintan dheeriga ah waxay si faahfaahsan u muujinaysaa dhammaan xaqiiqooyinka, marag-kacyada, iyo caddeymaha la xiriira kiiskan, kuwaas oo caddaynaya baaxadda khasaaraha iyo baahida loo qabo faragelin sharci oo degdeg ah si loo soo celiyo kala dambaynta.
